Building a free, all-in-one text analysis tool for SEO writers as a self-taught junior developer.
Press enter or click to view image in full size

It all started with a simple question.
My cousin works as an Arabic SEO writer. He spends his days writing, editing, and trying to get articles to rank on Google. A few months ago, I asked him a basic question: “What kind of tools do you actually need to do your job better?”
His answer surprised me. He wasn’t looking for complex AI or expensive software. He was just frustrated that his workflow was a mess.
He told me, “I need a tool where I can find almost anything in just one place. I want to highlight duplicate words, calculate my keyword density, and count my words without having to open three different websites. And I want to be able to download a report when I’m done.”
As a self-taught junior developer, I had been learning how to code by watching tutorials and practicing on my own. But I was looking for a real-world problem to solve.
When my cousin explained his frustration, I realized this was the perfect challenge.
Building the Solution
I opened my code editor and got to work. I wanted to build something fast, clean, and exactly tailored to what a professional writer needs.
After a lot of trial, error, and debugging, I finally finished it. It is my very first real, live online project, and I am incredibly proud of how it turned out.
If you write content and need to optimize your text, I built a free Arabic word counter that puts all the tools you need on one screen.
Here is exactly what I programmed it to do:

• Instant Word Counting: It accurately counts your characters and words as you type.

• Smart Highlighting: This was the hardest but most fun part to build. The tool automatically highlights 1-word, 2-word, and even 3-word repetitions so you can easily spot where you are overusing the same phrases.

• Keyword Density: It calculates exactly how often you are using your main keywords so you do not get penalized by search engines.

• Downloadable Reports: When you are finished editing, you can download a full keyword report with one click to send to your clients or save for your records.
The Best Part of Learning to Code
Seeing my cousin actually use the tool I built for his daily work is an amazing feeling.
Learning to code completely by myself hasn’t always been easy. There were a lot of days I wanted to quit when my code wouldn’t run. But launching this project and seeing real people use it makes all those late nights worth it.
If you are a writer, I hope this tool saves you time. And if you are a fellow junior developer, my advice is to stop just watching tutorials and start building things that solve real problems for the people around you!
